title: (RHBA-2020:5646) Update to Fuse 7.8.0 console images
portal_summary: Updated fuse console container images are now available for RHEL-7 based Middleware Containers.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.10|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.11|x86_64
portal_solution:
The RHEL-7 based Middleware Containers container images provided by this update can be downloaded from the Red Hat Container Registry at
registry.access.redhat.com. Installation instructions for your platform are
available at Red Hat Container Catalog (see References).

Dockerfiles and scripts should be amended either to refer to this new image
specifically, or to the latest image generally.
portal_description:
The Fuse 7.8 console container images have been updated for RHEL-7 based Middleware Containers to fix:

* ENTESB-15457 - [POST-GA] Fuse Console 7.8 Operator has wrong digest and can't be installed
* ENTESB-15455 - Documentation link points to 7.7 version in Fuse Console 7.8
